promptLatex: A circle has radius $6$. What is the area of the circle, in terms of $\pi$?
hintLatex: The area of a circle is the square of its radius times $\pi$.
solutionLatex:
The area of a circle is $\pi$ times the square of its radius.

The radius is $6$, so the area is $\pi \cdot 6^{2} = \pi \cdot 36 = 36\pi$.

The number $12\pi$ would be the circumference, $2 \pi r$, and it is the other quantity most often wanted from a circle with radius $6$.
